description: Upgrade matchup.coverage from STAB/type-level to movepool-based: a Pokémon 'covers' target type X if it can learn a damaging (physical/special) move whose type is super-effective against X — using pokemon_moves + moves + the type chart (matchups.counters_for gives the counter types; filter pokemon that EXISTS a learnable damaging move of a counter type). Keep the existing sp_attack/BST sort and legendary exclusion from T-015. Update the grounding NOTE to state coverage is judged by learnset (not just typing). Add unit/integration tests (e.g. a Water-type credited with Ice coverage via Ice Beam; legendaries excluded when asked) and update README/CLAUDE.md. Run make lint + make test.
title: Movepool-based type coverage in matchup retrieval
